mapper.sql: c.biz_contract_id, c.contract_no, c.vendor_id, v.company_nm AS vendor_nm, c.contract_type_cd, c.title, c.start_dt, c.end_dt, c.auto_renew_yn, c.renew_notice_days, c.amount_net, c.vat_amount, c.amount_total, c.vat_included_yn, c.currency_cd, c.payment_terms_cd, c.payment_day_of_month, c.owner_user_id, u.name AS owner_name, c.dept_id, d.dept_nm, c.status_cd, c.approval_doc_id, c.attach_group_id, c.memo, c.signed_at, c.terminated_at, c.termination_reason, c.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_biz_contract (contract_no, vendor_id, contract_type_cd, title, start_dt, end_dt, auto_renew_yn, renew_notice_days, amount_net, vat_amount, amount_total, vat_included_yn, currency_cd, payment_terms_cd, payment_day_of_month, owner_user_id, dept_id, status_cd, memo, created_by) VALUES (#{contractNo}, #{vendorId}, #{contractTypeCd}, #{title}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, COALESCE(#{autoRenewYn},'N'), COALESCE(#{renewNoticeDays}, 30), #{amountNet}, #{vatAmount}, #{amountTotal}, COALESCE(#{vatIncludedYn},'N'), COALESCE(#{currencyCd},'KRW'), COALESCE(#{paymentTermsCd},'LUMPSUM'), #{paymentDayOfMonth}, #{ownerUserId}, #{deptId}, COALESCE(#{statusCd},'DRAFT'), #{memo}, #{ownerUserId})
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_biz_contract SET title = #{title}, contract_type_cd = #{contractTypeCd}, start_dt = #{startDt}, end_dt = #{endDt}, auto_renew_yn = #{autoRenewYn}, renew_notice_days = #{renewNoticeDays}, amount_net = #{amountNet}, vat_amount = #{vatAmount}, amount_total = #{amountTotal}, vat_included_yn = #{vatIncludedYn}, currency_cd = #{currencyCd}, payment_terms_cd = #{paymentTermsCd}, payment_day_of_month = #{paymentDayOfMonth}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, dept_id = #{deptId}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE biz_contract_id = #{bizContractId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE gw_biz_contract SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE biz_contract_id = #{bizContractId}
UPDATE gw_biz_contract SET status_cd = #{statusCd}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE biz_contract_id = #{bizContractId}
UPDATE gw_biz_contract SET status_cd = 'ACTIVE', signed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE biz_contract_id = #{bizContractId} AND status_cd = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_biz_contract c JOIN gw_vendor v ON v.vendor_id = c.vendor_id LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = c.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = c.dept_id WHERE c.biz_contract_id = #{bizContractId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM gw_biz_contract c JOIN gw_vendor v ON v.vendor_id = c.vendor_id LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = c.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = c.dept_id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status_cd = 'ACTIVE' AND c.end_dt IS NOT NULL AND c.end_dt >= CURRENT_DATE AND c.end_dt <= DATEADD('DAY', #{days}, CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY c.end_dt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_billing_schedule (biz_contract_id, seq_no, due_dt, amount_net, vat_amount, amount_total, memo, status_cd) VALUES (#{bizContractId}, #{seqNo}, #{dueDt}, #{amountNet}, #{vatAmount}, #{amountTotal}, #{memo}, COALESCE(#{statusCd},'PENDING'))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM gw_billing_schedule WHERE status_cd = 'PENDING' AND due_dt >= CURRENT_DATE AND due_dt <= DATEADD('DAY', #{days}, CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY due_dt
